items.briefing:
Two alleged members of the cybercriminal group "TeamPCP" have been arrested in Australia, which is a positive development for local law enforcement efforts against cybercrime. Separately, a threat actor known as TA4922 is actively running tax-themed phishing attacks using malware called PackClient — this type of scam is particularly relevant as it may target Australian individuals and organisations during tax season, tricking people into clicking malicious links or attachments disguised as tax-related communications.

**Practical tip:** Be cautious of any unexpected emails about tax refunds, ATO notices, or financial deadlines — verify directly with the ATO before clicking any links or opening attachments.

featured.title: TrendAI tops CyberGym with 97% exploit-remediation rate
featured.summary: Enterprises could cut their exposure window as TrendAI's AESIR scored 97% on an independent benchmark against confirmed software flaws.
